_doc: The opening scenario's float (claude/opening-scenario.md). Coordinates are in the DOCK's own frame (pier centre at 0,0, heading 0 = +z). The float has no `at`: it sits at the ramp's foot, parallel to the pier (landing.mode side), the ramp square off the pier face (skew_deg 0). World translates/rotates the whole dock to the real town pier in the level and sets pier.height_m from the bathymetry. deck_navd_m: pier deck above NAVD 88; float deck_y is the float's deck at mid tide (freeboard above the water).
